1. (Currently amended) A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and an adhesive layer, the tool comprising first and second layers and __a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer__ having a substantially uniform thickness produced by placing __sheets of adhesive each having a substantially uniform thickness__ between the first and second layers, a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

2. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

3. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 282 wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

4. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 282 wherein the medial section is a composite material.

5. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

6. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

7. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

8. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

9. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 further including __a segmented weld ring comprising a plurality of discrete segments arranged around the perimeter__.

10. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

11. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 290 wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

12. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring.

13. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

14. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293 further including __a segmented weld ring comprising a plurality of discrete segments arranged around the outer periphery__.
